title: The Longest Clean Streak
prompt:
**Bài toán.** Given a lowercase string, print the length of the longest
substring in which no character repeats.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ |s| ≤ 200000.

**Output:** one integer.

tests.name: all same
all distinct
mid-string best
tests.hint: Best windows are length 2, and the winner starts mid-string.

tests.name: classic
tests.hint: abc / bca / cab are the length-3 windows.

tests.name: n=200000
tests.hint: Cyclic-ish pattern: the maximum possible is 26 (Python-verified); the adjacent-repeat-only wrong returns far more.
